summary: Iran peace signals eased oil and yields into the weekend, with the 10-year settling near 4.57%, but FOMC minutes confirmed most Fed officials still see rate hikes as possible if inflation persists. A four-year high in Manufacturing PMI added to that pressure, with factory input prices surging — keeping real rates elevated and gold under pressure while stocks hold greed territory on falling VIX.
tweet: Iran deal hopes cooled yields, but hawkish FOMC minutes and surging factory input prices keep rate-hike risk alive — stocks greed, gold in fear.
